hypothesis: Catalogue inclusion is Selected At Random conditional on observables (local relief, slope, gravity-derived basin-fill thickness, verified 1 m lidar coverage, and distance to the basin-margin range front). Correcting that selection propensity with SAR-EM and training with the propensity-aware empirical risk recovers withheld fault segments better than an nnPU baseline on identical spatially blocked folds.
mechanism: e(x)=P(s=1|y=1,x) is estimated with SAR-EM (Bekker & Davis, PMLR v94, 2018): f_hat(x)=P(s=1|x) is fit by logistic regression on the five covariates, the latent posterior pi(x) is refit each M-step with importance weights 1/e clipped at 10, and e is rescaled so E_{x|y=1}[e]=c. The detector is trained with the exact propensity-aware empirical risk of Bekker, Robberechts & Davis (arXiv:1809.03207) with the Kiryo et al. non-negative guard and ramp-up; the nnPU baseline is the same risk with e==1 (no importance weights). Emission is a greedy maximum-coverage packing of the metric's own dispersed credit map.
named_non_fault_process_that_could_mimic: Landslide scarps and erosional drainage breaks produce steep local relief and slope that resemble fault scarps; lithologic and density contacts create linear topographic and gravity contrasts; basin-margin geometry and non-tectonic fill-thickness changes produce gravity gradients without faults; and survey/mapping effort itself correlates with access and geologic interest, so a propensity model can absorb prevalence rather than detectability.

promotion_reason: The propensity-aware candidate at lambda = 0.5 beats the matched nnPU baseline on identical blocked folds for the pooled blocked-holdout DTI (0.0234 vs 0.0221) AND for the leakage-free off-catalogue SGMC DTI (0.0247 vs 0.0219), loses nothing in any propensity tercile, is unique against all 82 prior rasters (max |rank corr| 0.00742, max 3-px dot overlap 0.329004), and passes the format validator with every one of the 12,279,160 cells finite and in [0,1].
what_is_not_claimed: No organizer score is claimed. No leaderboard position is claimed or projected. The absolute holdout proxy value (~0.023) is far below the public board range; the evidenced claim is the paired improvement over nnPU on identical folds, nothing more. No 95% CI was computed. The propensity scale c is reported as unidentified. The 1 m lidar covariate covers only 34,094 of 5,167,373 footprint pixels (0.66%) and the range-front covariate is an operational proxy, not an independently mapped front.
